name: umfp
description: Universal Mathematical Formula Passport — a deterministic structural analysis and classification layer for mathematical formulas.

scripts.test: tsx -e "import { runAllGoldenTests } from './src/umfp-core/golden-tests'; const s = runAllGoldenTests(); console.log(s.passed + '/' + s.total, 'failed=' + s.failed); if (s.failed) process.exit(1);"
scripts.test:semantic: tsx -e "import { runSemanticExtensionTests } from './src/umfp-semantic/semantic-tests'; const s = runSemanticExtensionTests(); console.log(s.passed + '/' + s.total, 'failed=' + s.failed); if (s.failed) process.exit(1);"
